title: Proposal Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for a
 **Proposal Engineer** 
 with 2\+ years of experience in the
 **Oil \& Gas / EPC industry** 
 to support tendering, proposal preparation, cost estimation, and bid evaluation activities. The ideal candidate should have good technical understanding of engineering projects, commercial awareness, and the ability to prepare accurate and competitive proposals within defined timelines.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Review and analyze RFQs, ITTs, RFPs, tender documents, specifications, drawings, BOQs, and scope of work.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Projects, and other internal teams to understand project requirements.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals in line with client requirements and tender conditions.
* Prepare cost estimates, quantity take\-offs, rate analysis, and pricing for engineering and project activities.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors/subcontractors and incorporate relevant costs into proposals.
* Prepare Bid Comparison Statements and support bid evaluation based on technical and commercial requirements.
* Identify project scope, exclusions, assumptions, deviations, and commercial risks during the tendering stage.
* Support preparation of man\-hours, resource requirements, project schedules, and execution estimates.
* Analyze tender requirements and ensure all mandatory documents and deliverables are included in the submission.
* Coordinate with technical teams for clarification of engineering requirements and scope\-related queries.
* Prepare tender queries, clarification requests, and deviation statements for client submission.
* Maintain and update proposal databases, costing sheets, vendor quotations, and historical project cost information.
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations as required.
* Ensure proposals are submitted accurately and within the specified tender deadlines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of submitted bids and proposal\-related activities.


 Key Skills
   

  

* Tender Management \& Tender Analysis
* Cost Estimation \& Rate Analysis
* Bid Evaluation
* Technical \& Commercial Proposal Preparation
* RFQ / RFP / ITT Analysis
* BOQ \& Quantity Take\-off
* Vendor / Subcontractor Quotation Evaluation
* Bid Comparison Statements
* Commercial \& Technical Compliance
* Scope, Exclusions \& Deviation Analysis
* Good knowledge of Oil \& Gas / EPC project requirements
* Strong MS Excel skills
* Good communication, coordination, and analytical skills


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical / Chemical / Civil / Electrical / relevant discipline).
* Candidates with experience in Oil \& Gas, EPC, Engineering Consultancy, or Project Services will be preferred.


**Experience**
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in Proposal Engineering, Tendering, Estimation, Bidding, or Pre\-Sales within the Oil \& Gas / EPC industry.
* Experience handling technical and commercial tenders will be an added advantage.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Ability to interpret technical documents, specifications, drawings, and BOQs.
* Good understanding of project costing and estimation methodologies.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Strong coordination skills with Engineering, Procurement, Vendors, and Project teams.
* Detail\-oriented with a focus on accuracy and timely submission of proposals.

 Studio Scintilla \| Powered by Craftsville

 Sales \& Commercial

 • Strong understanding of interior design, styles, materials, and residential interiors

 Supplier Onboarding \& Transaction Enablement

* Ensure supplier enablement activities adhere to enterprise compliance, risk management, master data governance, security, and system control requirements, escalating exceptions and risks as necessary. (Owns)


 Supplier Support \& Issue Resolution
   

  

* Act as the primary point of accountability for supplier enablement success, monitoring supplier progress from onboarding through steady\-state adoption and transaction compliance. (Owns)

* Recommend process enhancements, automation opportunities, and platform optimization initiatives to improve supplier experience, operational efficiency, and compliance outcomes. (Consulted / Leads)
* Support enterprise supplier migration initiatives, digital transformation programs, and SAP Ariba capability expansion projects, ensuring successful supplier adoption and change management. (Executes)


 Collaboration \& Governance Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, Finance, IT, Master Data, Risk, Compliance, SAP Ariba, and Governance teams to develop and execute supplier enablement strategies aligned with enterprise objectives. (Consulted / Executes)
* Influence supplier and stakeholder decision\-making through data\-driven recommendations, adoption insights, and subject matter expertise in supplier enablement and SAP Ariba processes. (Executes)
* Participate in governance forums, operational reviews, supplier performance discussions, and transformation initiatives to ensure alignment with business priorities and digital procurement goals. (Consulted)
* Serve as a trusted advisor and escalation point for supplier enablement strategy, enterprise licensing adoption, supplier experience, and SAP Ariba operational excellence initiatives. (Owns)


**Qualifications**
* 9\-11 years of experience in supplier enablement or procurement operations, with exposure to downstream AP operations within a shared services or global delivery environment
* Hands\-on experience supporting supplier onboarding or transaction enablement in SAP environments
* Experience working in a global or multi\-regional operating model
